check_notes.subject_lock: The prompt locks one dark-charcoal top-freezer refrigerator with fixed door layout, recessed handles, trim, proportions and forbidden redesigns.
check_notes.view_coverage: All required front, 45-degree, side and rear views are explicitly listed and must keep the full appliance visible.
check_notes.camera_specificity: The smartphone capture profile specifies focal length equivalent, aperture, shutter, ISO, white balance, camera height, subject distance and lighting.
check_notes.cross_view_consistency: The prompt states that every panel is the exact same physical refrigerator and names geometry that must remain unchanged.
check_notes.photographic_realism: Natural indoor daylight, restrained HDR, realistic coated-metal reflections and anti-CGI constraints support a believable phone-photo look.
check_notes.technical_safety: The prompt forbids invented hidden refrigeration internals and limits A0 to visible product geometry.
check_notes.ambiguity: Product identity, required views, capture profile, environment, board layout and forbidden changes are sufficiently constrained.

summary: The A0 prompt is sufficiently specific to generate a realistic multi-view reference board while preserving one refrigerator identity across all required angles.
